title: 富兰克林坦伯顿ChristyTan：地缘与通胀压力下，反弹能否持续？
speaker: Kristie Tan

segments.en: the developments that we're hearing when it comes to how Beijing is approaching some of these possible curbs from their companies as well as that broader theme of AI investors just turning more discerning
segments.zh: 我们听到关于北京如何应对企业可能面临的限制，以及AI主题下投资者变得更加挑剔的进展。

segments.en: we've seen that sort of cashing out of some very crowded trades widening the search for more undervalued opportunities they're getting harder to find
segments.zh: 我们看到一些拥挤交易被获利了结，投资者在寻找更低估的机会，但这类机会越来越难找。

segments.en: let's bring now from Singapore Kristie Tan has a global investment strategist at Franklin Templeton Institute and Kristie really great to have you with us so we are seeing a day where geopolitical tensions the revival of these concerns and oil now back in the spotlight as well as broader inflation concerns are now top of mind
segments.zh: 现在连线新加坡的Kristie Tan，她是富兰克林坦伯顿研究所的全球市场策略师。今天我们看到地缘政治紧张局势重燃，油价重回焦点，通胀担忧也成为市场核心议题。

segments.en: is this something that investors have been pretty happy to shrug off today but is it something that now creates that risk for rally that is already looking very very hated so that's an interesting question
segments.zh: 投资者今天似乎对这些风险不以为意，但这是否会给已经备受质疑的反弹带来风险？这是个有趣的问题。

segments.en: I think we started a year saying that you know the markets were probably broadened out and the equity markets concentration has been one of the key themes observed and this AI and KPACs and earnings momentum has kept you know markets and investors buffered against all the shocks
segments.zh: 我认为年初我们就提到市场可能会扩散，权益市场集中度一直是关键主题。AI、资本支出和盈利动能让市场和投资者抵御了各种冲击。

segments.en: that's coming from the geopolitics and the oil situation as well as inflation risks but I think you're probably right that you know geopolitics continue to be one of the key themes and one of the key concerns that a lot of investors especially medium term ones are still very very focused on
segments.zh: 这些冲击来自地缘政治、油价和通胀风险。但你说得对，地缘政治仍是关键主题，许多投资者，尤其是中期投资者，仍然高度关注。

segments.en: and this will drive you know the kind of inflation profile which recently we've seen the fall in oil prices and we thought that you know because of the US Iran situation and cease fire but obviously that is not something that is very concrete in fact it is a shaky ceasefire and an MOU is not a deal so the peace deal I think is still in question and that brings about continued overall concerns especially in the geopolitics front
segments.zh: 这将影响通胀走势。近期油价下跌，我们曾认为是因为美伊局势和停火，但显然停火并不稳固，谅解备忘录不等于协议，和平协议仍存疑，这持续引发整体担忧，尤其是地缘政治方面。
